title: Selecting through the missing key still gives null
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
import * from dw::core::Arrays
output application/json
---
(leftJoin([{orderId:'O3',customerId:99}], [{id:1,name:'Ann'}], (o) -> o.customerId as String, (c) -> c.id as String))[0].r.name

solution:
%dw 2.0
import * from dw::core::Arrays
output application/json
---
(leftJoin([{orderId:'O3',customerId:99}], [{id:1,name:'Ann'}], (o) -> o.customerId as String, (c) -> c.id as String))[0].r.name

explanation.approach: `.r` is absent, and DataWeave selectors on a missing or null value keep returning null rather than erroring. `$.r.name` already does the right thing for an unmatched order with no extra handling.
